content.title: Representations of spectral systems over finite distributive lattices
content.abstract: A representation theorem is proved for spectral systems indexed by the lattice of down-sets of a finite poset P. Over an arbitrary associative ring, every excisive, homotopy-exact chain system of differential modules is isomorphic to the chain system of a projective P-graded differential module with a single upper-triangular differential. Consequently, every Cartan-Eilenberg system that is excisive and chain generated, together with its spectral system, admits such a differential model.
